changes:
- Version 5.3.1 tester build.
- The app now relaunches itself after installing an update.
- Retiring an older release no longer removes the current version's download link.
- Updates tab no longer shows the update address, and Open download page is gone.
- Update Pending is shown when a newer version has no download link.
- Licence screen on first start: send the machine ID to get a licence file.
- Sweep limit presets in Settings: Low 256, Medium 1,024, High 4,096, Extreme 65,536, or Custom.
